risks.risk: Keyboard may not be fully functional (some keys, buttons, or sound/tones may be faulty).
risks.proof: A short video showing power-on, LCD working, pressing multiple keys across the full range, and playing a few notes/tones (with volume audible).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully proven working (worst case: treat as needing testing/possible partial faults).

risks.risk: Speakers/headphone output may be weak or distorted.
risks.proof: Video/audio clip playing through built-in speakers and (if possible) through headphones/line-out.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as speaker output not guaranteed (worst case: assume speaker issues until proven).

risks.risk: Power adapter/charging or power supply may be missing or unreliable.

risks.if_unproven: Priced as power supply not guaranteed (worst case: buyer may need to replace/confirm adapter).

risks.risk: LCD/backlight or display may be damaged even if it powers on.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the LCD with readable screen content after turning on.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as display condition uncertain (worst case: assume display may be dim/partially faulty).

proof_requests: Send a short video: power-on + LCD clearly visible + play across low/middle/high keys.
Show audio output clearly (built-in speakers) and, if possible, headphone/line-out.
Confirm what accessories are included (power adapter) with a photo of the adapter label.
Close-up photos of keybed condition (any stuck keys) and the LCD screen.
response.reason: The model (Yamaha PSR-175) is readable from the photo, but the seller’s “working perfectly” claim is not proven by any power-on/audio/video evidence. Request quick functional proof before pricing confidently.
